limitations_and_boundaries: Data derived from cancer cell lines, not primary cells or in vivo models.
Drug treatments limited to 24-hour duration; chronic or time-course effects not captured.
Only transcriptomic readouts; protein-level or phenotypic data not included.
Potential batch effects addressed via DMSO controls per plate, but not fully eliminated; biological replicate plate shows high correlation.
Cell cycle phase is a major confounder in transcriptomic variation.
Only 47 of 50 cell lines had sufficient representation for downstream analysis.
E-distance and Vision scores may not capture all subtle drug effects.

research_questions.statement: How does the Tahoe-100M atlas enable AI-driven models of the cell by providing a large-scale single-cell perturbation resource?

provenance.text_excerpt: RMC-6236, a pan-RAS inhibitor, produced the greatest effect in the KRAS-mutated group, with the most substantial difference in Vision scores observed at the lowest (p = 0.065, Welch’s t-test) and intermediate (p = 0.063, Welch’s t-test) doses compared to the unmutated RAS group. These results underscore the KRAS-specific action of RMC-6236

claims.statement: RMC-6236 (pan-RAS inhibitor) preferentially reduces MAPK pathway activity in KRAS-mutated cell lines compared to RAS wild-type lines.

provenance.text_excerpt: cell line identity, followed by cell cycle phase, are the most major factors in driving stratification of the data. And as expected, drug treatment and dose have a more modest effect relative to these factors

claims.statement: Cell line identity and cell cycle phase are the primary drivers of transcriptomic variation in the atlas, with drug treatment having a more modest global effect.

provenance.text_excerpt: Our high-throughput Mosaic platform, composed of a highly diverse and optimally balanced "cell village", reduces batch effects and enables parallel profiling of thousands of conditions at single-cell resolution at an unprecedented scale

claims.statement: Mosaic platform reduces batch effects via a diverse 'cell village' design and enables parallel profiling of thousands of conditions at single-cell resolution.

provenance.text_excerpt: Tahoe-100M, a giga-scale single-cell atlas of 100 million transcriptomic profiles measuring how each of 1,100 small-molecule perturbations impact cells across 50 cancer cell lines. ... As the largest single-cell dataset to date, Tahoe-100M enables artificial-intelligence (AI)-driven models to learn context-dependent functions

claims.statement: The Tahoe-100M atlas is the largest single-cell perturbation dataset to date, enabling AI-driven models to learn context-dependent gene functions and regulatory dynamics.

provenance.text_excerpt: Dabrafenib elicited the most pronounced effect in cell lines harboring BRAF mutations, as evidenced by significantly lower scores at both the lowest (P = 0.0013, Welch’s t-test) and highest (P = 0.00023, Welch’s t-test) doses, whereas KRAS-mutated lines showed minimal change. Given that KRAS activating mutations occur upstream of BRAF activating mutations, these findings align with the expected dynamics

claims.statement: Dabrafenib (BRAF-V600E inhibitor) shows stronger transcriptomic effect in BRAF-mutated cell lines compared to KRAS-mutated lines, consistent with RAS/RAF pathway dynamics.

provenance.text_excerpt: Palbociclib and Dinaciclib exhibited distinct enrichments, with Palbociclib showing enrichment in the G1 phase and Dinaciclib in the G2/M phase. This is in contrast to the other CDK inhibitors — Abemaciclib, AT5719, and Ribociclib — which displayed little to no enrichment

claims.statement: Different CDK4/6 inhibitors exhibit distinct cell cycle phase enrichment profiles: Palbociclib enriches G1, Dinaciclib enriches G2/M, while Abemaciclib, AT5719, and Ribociclib show little enrichment.

datasets.description: Single-cell transcriptomic profiles of 50 cancer cell lines treated with 379 drugs (1,135 drug-dose combinations) across 14 96-well plates, processed via Parse GigaLab kit and SNP-based deconvolution.
datasets.name: Tahoe-100M

evidence_spans.content: Atlas captures 17,813 unique cell line-drug conditions, 31-fold increase over benchmark single-cell drug screen (Srivatsan et al. 2020) and 29-fold increase in observations per condition over benchmark genetic perturbation screen (Replogle et al. 2022).

provenance.text_excerpt: This dataset captures 17,813 unique cell line-drug conditions, representing a 31-fold increase in the number of drug-perturbed conditions compared to a benchmark single-cell drug screen (Srivatsan et al. 2020) and a 29-fold increase in the number of observations per condition compared to a benchmark genetic perturbation screen (Replogle et al. 2022)

evidence_spans.content: Dinaciclib inhibits CDK1, CDK2, CDK5, CDK9 and induces G2/M arrest; Palbociclib selectively targets CDK4/6 and facilitates G1-to-S transition.

provenance.text_excerpt: Dinaciclib inhibits CDK1, CDK2, CDK5, and CDK9 and has been shown to induce G2/M phase arrest, whereas Palbociclib selectively targets CDK4/6 — responsible for phosphorylating the retinoblastoma protein (Rb) and facilitating the transition from G1 to S phase

evidence_spans.content: Plate 14 served as biological replicate of Plate 6; pseudobulk Pearson correlation for matched treatment and cell identity median 0.975 (q25:0.97, q75:0.98) versus unmatched median 0.915.

provenance.text_excerpt: we included Plate 14 as a biological replicate of Plate 6 ... higher correlation between conditions with matched treatment and cell identity (estimate q25: 0.97, median: 0.975, q75: 0.98) compared to unmatched comparisons between the two plates (estimate q25: 0.892, median: 0.915, q75: 0.929)

experiments_or_tasks: Batch effect assessment: DMSO-treated wells as controls; biological replicate plates showed high pseudobulk correlation (median 0.975) for matched conditions.
Generation of Tahoe-100M atlas using Mosaic platform: 50 cancer cell lines, 1,100 drug perturbations, 24-hour treatment, scRNA-seq via Parse GigaLab kit.
Quality control: 153 million cells raw, 100.6 million passing minimal filters, 95.6 million passing full filters.

methods.name: Mosaic platform cell culture and treatment
methods.protocol_description: Spheroids of 50 mixed cancer cell lines cultured in suspension, treated with drugs or DMSO for 24 hours, dissociated, fixed, and profiled using Parse GigaLab scRNA-seq kit with combinatorial barcoding.

methods.name: SNP-based cell line deconvolution
methods.protocol_description: Genetic variants detected from scRNA-seq libraries used for SNP-based deconvolution to assign cells to cell line of origin.

methods.name: Dimensionality reduction and visualization
methods.protocol_description: scVI used to learn 10-dimensional embedding; subsample of 6.58 million cells (140,000 per cell line) used for tSNE visualization.

methods.name: E-distance calculation
methods.protocol_description: E-distance computed from scVI embeddings to quantify separability of perturbed vs control populations.

methods.name: Differential gene set expression (Vision)
methods.protocol_description: Vision used to compute gene-set expression scores per cell; differential scores between aggregated treatment and control conditions.

methods.name: Cell cycle phase enrichment analysis
methods.protocol_description: Log2 odds ratio computed for percentage of cells in each cell cycle phase relative to control condition.

study_units.name: Atlas generation and quality assessment

provenance.text_excerpt: Cells had a mean of 2,288 transcripts (median of 1,890)

results.value_raw_text: Median 1,890 transcripts per cell across full atlas; per-plate medians range from 1,462 to 2,159.

provenance.text_excerpt: obtained ~1.4 trillion raw sequencing reads representing a total of 153 million cells ... 100.6 million cells that pass minimal filters and 95.6 million cells that pass full filters

results.value_raw_text: 153 million raw cells, 100.6 million passing minimal filters, 95.6 million passing full filters.

results.metric_name: Log2 odds ratio cell cycle phase enrichment

provenance.text_excerpt: Palbociclib showing enrichment in the G1 phase and Dinaciclib in the G2/M phase ... HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induced the greatest G2/M arrest. Within the HDAC inhibitors, Belinostat and Panobinostat predominantly drove this G2/M enrichment, in contrast to Carbamazepine ... little enrichment—and Tucidinostat (Chidamide), which demonstrated a negative enrichment

results.value_raw_text: Palbociclib enriched in G1 phase; Dinaciclib enriched in G2/M phase; HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induce G2/M arrest; Belinostat and Panobinostat drive G2/M enrichment; Carbamazepine little enrichment; Tucidinostat negative enrichment.

provenance.text_excerpt: observed a larger median E-distance at the highest drug doses across treatments ... harringtonine and homoharringtonine ... dinaciclib ... proteasome inhibitors, HDAC inhibitors and PI3K/AKT inhibitors tended to have larger effects

results.value_raw_text: Drug perturbations with higher dose exhibit larger median E-distance; outliers include harringtonine, homoharringtonine, dinaciclib; classes like proteasome inhibitors and HDAC inhibitors show larger effects.
